text.en: Thiruvalluvar says a great deal in two short lines.

Thirukkural, by Thiruvalluvar, is a universal book of ethics with 1330 couplets (குறள்) in 133 chapters, divided into three parts: அறம் (virtue), பொருள் (wealth) and இன்பம் (love). The textbook gives selected couplets for this unit.
Each kural has seven words in two lines, a short form called kural venba. The couplets teach conduct and humanity. For this unit the selection links to culture and human values.
For each kural learn the meaning of every word, the central message and the chapter heading. Learn the terms குறள் வெண்பா, அதிகாரம் (chapter) and அறம்.
